description: Search the ads in TikTok's public Ad Library by keyword: each ad's advertiser, title, industry, when it first and last ran, its video or images, the audience range and impressions, about 12 a page. TikTok's library holds ads shown in Europe. Use this to watch what a brand or a category advertises. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

query.description: A brand, an advertiser or words in the ad.

name: search_tiktok_ads
